title: Caleb
lead: Caleb son of Jephunneh, one of the twelve scouts, who with Joshua urged Israel to trust God and enter Canaan. With Joshua, he was the only man of his generation to enter the land, and he took Hebron in his old age (Numbers 13–14; Joshua 14–15).

sections.b: Caleb is named Judah's scout in Numbers 13:6 but is elsewhere called "the Kenizzite" (Numbers 32:12; Joshua 14:6), a clan with Edomite links (Genesis 36:11), so he may stand for outsiders who joined Israel. He "followed the LORD fully" (Numbers 14:24; Deuteronomy 1:36). At eighty-five he asks for the hill country of Hebron and drives out the Anakim (Joshua 14:6–15; 15:13–19). His younger brother, or perhaps his nephew, Othniel (Judges 1:13 can be read either way), becomes the first judge (Judges 1:12–15; 3:9–11).
